result.instructions: Tools for Temp Stick, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our temperature sensors have not checked in recently?"; "Show the last 24 hours of readings for the freezer sensor."; "List the temperature alert notifications from this week.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Temp Stick data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run tempstick_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run tempstick_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run tempstick_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. tempstick_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: tempstick_list_sensors
tools.title: List sensors
tools.description: List the Temp Stick sensors on the account with their names, ids and last and next check-in times (UTC). Good first call to find sensor ids. Temp Stick API: GET /sensors/all.

tools.name: tempstick_get_sensor
tools.title: Get a sensor
tools.description: Get one Temp Stick sensor's details, including its name and check-in times. Temp Stick API: GET /sensor/{sensor_id}.

sensor_id.description: The sensor id, for example TS00ABC123 (from tempstick_list_sensors).

tools.name: tempstick_get_readings
tools.title: Get sensor readings
tools.description: Get the readings of one sensor: temperature in Celsius, humidity, voltage, RSSI and sensor_time (UTC). `setting` picks the time range; the vendor example uses 24_hours. Temp Stick API: GET /sensor/{sensor_id}/readings.

sensor_id.description: The sensor id, for example TS00ABC123 (from tempstick_list_sensors).

setting.description: Time range, for example 24_hours (the default). Other values are not listed by the vendor docs.

offset.description: Query offset as the vendor example uses it (21600). The vendor docs do not state its unit.

tools.name: tempstick_list_alerts
tools.title: List alert notifications
tools.description: List the alert notifications on the account with the sensor id, the alert message and the created time (UTC). Temp Stick API: GET /user/notifications.
